corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The slopes measure 0.761 and 0.747.

corrections.what: Mirrored the official and lectern about x 188.4: head r 9.56, a flat-topped body with 4 px corners and vertical sides, a lectern top narrowing from 57.8 to 52.8 px, and two vertical legs

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. The icon measures 5.25 px; the body's top line runs about 4.5 px, so at W it sits 0.5 px heavier at each edge.

notes: Kept: the pediment, entablature band, five columns, doubled baseline band, the bracket's open left arms, the nub and dot, the official's head clear of the body by a small gap, the lectern and its two legs.
